mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_video WHERE training_id=#{videoTrainingId}) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_material_page p JOIN training_material m ON m.id=p.material_id WHERE m.training_id=#{materialTrainingId})

SELECT s.phone,s.candidate_name,s.completed_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidate_video_progress p JOIN training_video v ON v.id=p.video_id WHERE p.session_id=s.id AND v.training_id=t.id AND p.completed=TRUE) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM candidate_material_progress p JOIN training_material m ON m.id=p.material_id WHERE p.session_id=s.id AND m.training_id=t.id AND p.completed=TRUE) completed_parts FROM candidate_learning_session s JOIN training t ON (t.assessment_id=s.task_id OR t.id=s.training_id) WHERE t.id=#{trainingId} AND (s.training_id=t.id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM training_audience r WHERE r.training_id=t.id AND r.candidate_name=s.candidate_name AND r.phone=s.phone))

SELECT s.id,s.completed_at completedAt,s.candidate_name name,s.phone,s.task_id taskId,COALESCE(a.department_name,'') department FROM candidate_learning_session s JOIN training t ON (t.assessment_id=s.task_id OR t.id=s.training_id) LEFT JOIN training_audience a ON a.training_id=t.id AND a.phone=s.phone WHERE t.id=#{trainingId} AND (s.training_id=t.id OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM training_audience r WHERE r.training_id=t.id AND r.candidate_name=s.candidate_name AND r.phone=s.phone)) ORDER BY s.id DESC

SELECT v.id,v.title,p.position_seconds positionSeconds,p.studied_seconds studiedSeconds,p.completed,p.first_studied_at firstStudiedAt,p.updated_at lastStudiedAt,p.completed_at completedAt FROM training_video v LEFT JOIN candidate_video_progress p ON p.video_id=v.id AND p.session_id=#{trainingId} WHERE v.training_id=#{sessionTrainingId} ORDER BY v.sort_order,v.id

SELECT m.id,m.title,p.page_number pageNumber,p.required_seconds requiredSeconds,r.studied_seconds studiedSeconds,r.completed,r.first_seen firstStudiedAt,r.last_seen lastStudiedAt,r.completed_at completedAt FROM training_material m JOIN training_material_page p ON p.material_id=m.id LEFT JOIN candidate_material_progress r ON r.material_id=m.id AND r.page_number=p.page_number AND r.session_id=#{trainingId} WHERE m.training_id=#{sessionTrainingId} ORDER BY m.sort_order,m.id,p.page_number

SELECT a.id,a.attempt_no attemptNo,a.status,a.started_at startedAt,a.submitted_at submittedAt,CASE WHEN a.submitted_at IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(0,TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND,a.started_at,a.submitted_at)) END durationSeconds,a.score,a.total_score totalScore,a.passed FROM assessment_attempt a JOIN assessment_participant p ON p.id=a.participant_id WHERE a.task_id=#{taskId} AND p.phone=#{phone} AND p.candidate_name=#{candidateName} ORDER BY a.attempt_no
